image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a blue mesh baby bib lying on a white textured surface (likely a towel). The bib features a dark blue trim and a central graphic print depicting a slice of red velvet cake with white frosting, alongside scattered crumbs or nuts. Below the food illustration, there is stylized white text that appears to read 'HAPPY EASTER' or similar, though the letters are distorted and fused. The mesh texture of the bib is clearly visible.

artifact_observations.location: Lower central region of the bib
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white lettering at the bottom is structurally incoherent. Characters are fused, malformed, and lack clear definition, exhibiting classic AI-generated text artifacts where the model mimics the shape of letters without forming legible words.

The printed cake image has a slightly 'painted' or smudged quality that doesn't perfectly align with the underlying mesh grid. The edges of the cake slice bleed slightly into the mesh texture rather than sitting crisply on top of it.

artifact_observations.location: Top right edge of the bib
artifact_observations.reasoning: The dark blue trim on the upper right side appears to warp and thin out unnaturally, losing its consistent width and structural rigidity expected in a sewn hem.
